labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reporter describes unexpected column width behaviour with a runnable example; related to open #2890.

items.body:
Thanks for the detailed report. The first attempt wraps because `overflow` only takes effect on a column with `no_wrap=True`, so your second attempt is the one that applies ellipsis. The other columns being squashed in that second attempt looks like a width-allocation defect; a related open issue is #2890 (`no_wrap` squashing columns below their `min_width`).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
